faqs.question: What carpet cleaning methods do you use?
faqs.answer: We use industry-leading carpet cleaning methods tailored to your home’s needs: Steam Cleaning (Hot Water Extraction) for deep cleaning and Low-Moisture Cleaning for faster drying.

faqs.question: How long does it take for carpets to dry after cleaning?
faqs.answer: Drying time depends on the cleaning method: Steam Cleaning takes 6–12 hours, while Low-Moisture Cleaning takes 2–4 hours.

faqs.question: Can you remove pet stains and odors?
faqs.answer: Yes. We use specialized cleaning solutions and techniques designed to neutralize pet odors and remove stains at the source, not just cover them up.
